title: End-to-end pipeline runbook
context: Once the pipeline is repeatable it needs a documented runbook so any contributor can take a scenario pack from English-pivot to a delivered, reviewed, licensed pack. The runbook captures every stage and gate. It depends on translate-001 and the license-check tooling.
objective: Write the end-to-end pipeline runbook covering every stage from phrase-bank to delivered pack.
acceptanceCriteria: Documents the full pipeline: phrase selection, license clearance, drafting, review gates (tier-aware), localization, license/attribution check, assembly, and delivery
References the schemas, templates, glossaries, locales, and tooling used at each stage
States the hard gates (license-000 before drafting, disclaimer presence, Tier-C back-translation, sign-offs) and where each is recorded
Usable by a new contributor to run a pack end-to-end
